visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with dark, slightly messy hair sits on outdoor concrete stairs during high-noon daylight. He wears a short-sleeved white button-down shirt with a blue tie. He is eating rice and vegetables with wooden chopsticks from a takeaway box. The background shows lush green trees and a large yellow dome-like geodesic structure. (2) A hand belonging to an unseen character in a blue shirt extends a green plastic cup with pink branding towards the man. The man stops eating and looks up with an exaggerated, bulging-eyed expression of shock and surprise. The lighting is bright and even. (3) A close-up of the man's face displays an intense romantic longing. The frame is overlaid with high-saturation graphics of white jasmine flowers and pink heart icons. He grips the green beverage cup tightly while the background blurs significantly. (4) The scene shifts to an indoor office with a minimalist white background. The man sits at a desk with a silver laptop. A character wearing a long brown wig and a blue shirt (a female persona) struggles to open a transparent water bottle. The man observes this and prepares to help. (5) The man rolls up his sleeve and strains to open the bottle, his face turning red with effort. He later stretches his arms, flexing his biceps in a white-shirted office setting while holding the green drink. The character in the wig watches him from the side. (6) On an outdoor volleyball court, a man in a green t-shirt and black cap spikes a ball. The character in the wig falls to the green court surface. The man in the white shirt rushes in, sliding onto his knees and holding his shoulder with a small red mark on his lip. (7) The man and another male character in a green tank top stand side-by-side outdoors. They both hold the green CoCo cups and look up at the bright blue sky with joyful, wide-mouthed laughter. The camera angle is low, looking up at them against the sun.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) Audio begins with the ambient sound of an outdoor park environment, including light wind. The speaker makes crunching eating noises. A character in a high-pitched, feminine voice offers a drink. (2) A sudden romantic cinematic swell with strings and piano erupts. The main male voice shifts into a fast-paced, high-arousal narration style with heavy reverb on specific words like 'Love.' (3) A digital alert SFX transitions to a steady hip-hop electronic beat with a heavy bass kick. The male voice grunts with physical effort, then adopts a cool, lower-pitched tone to address a female colleague. (4) A loud percussive 'Thud' and 'Whoosh' SFX accompany a transition. A melancholic, slow piano ballad begins. The male voice becomes shaky and melodramatic, speaking with heavy pauses and high pitch variability. (5) The music stops for a brief explanatory dialogue in a neutral tone. It then swells into an acoustic guitar and piano cover of 'A Whole New World.' Two male voices sing joyfully in harmony, followed by loud, bright laughter.
